label: 32-bit Montgomery packed sumcheck, direct 2^28
note: Six-layer checker sumcheck (gkr_checker, six 2^28 layer tables padded) with 32-bit subtractive Montgomery (R=2^32) replacing INT64 % in every Triton pass, transcripts bit-identical to reference.py at every k (36 tests). DIRECT 2^28 point: k=3 17.69 ms/layer -> 145.9 ms/batch padded (86.5 unpadded) = 35.6 us/VU vs a-packed's 62.7 (extrapolated) = 1.76x; k=2 19.8 ms, k=4 (unfused 768-row block) 31.0 ms.
